subject: E-Commerce
title: PayPal's Wild Origin
description: A short lesson to help you apply PayPal's Wild Origin.

hook.text: PayPal started as a way to beam money between Palm Pilots. Nobody used it. Then eBay sellers discovered it.

buildup.text: eBay sellers needed a way to accept payments without merchant accounts. PayPal filled that gap perfectly.

discovery.text: PayPal gave $10 to every new signup and $10 per referral. It grew to 1 million users in months.

twist.text: eBay tried to build its own payment system, Billpoint. It failed. eBay bought PayPal for $1.5 billion.

climax.text: PayPal's founding team—Musk, Thiel, Levchin—became the 'PayPal Mafia' who built Tesla, LinkedIn, YouTube.

punchline.text: Palm Pilot flop to $1.5B acquisition. PayPal found its market by accident.

quiz.question: What originally was PayPal designed for?
